newsitem.title: CHINA: France's AXA UAP to get China licence.
newsitem.headline: France's AXA UAP to get China licence.

text.p: French insurer AXA UAP will gain permission to do direct business in China during this week's visit to Beijing by French President Jacques Chirac, a French diplomat in Shanghai said on Tuesday.
The diplomat said no details of the arrangement were available.
AXA first set up a representative office in China in 1989 and now has offices in Beijing, Shanghai and the southern city of Guangzhou.
Scores of foreign insurers have offices in China, but only a handful are allowed to issue policies here, including American International Assurance Co Ltd and Tokio Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd.
Chirac begins a four-day visit to China on Thursday.
